claims.claim: RBench evaluates robot-oriented video generation across five task domains and four embodiments with task-level and visual-fidelity sub-metrics (Figure 1).
limitations: video generation was not rerun; metric values are structural not empirical

observations.summary: Census: 5 task categories, 4 embodiment categories, 650 total prompts

claims.claim: The benchmark evaluates 25 open-source, commercial, and robotics-specific video models across task and embodiment dimensions (Table 2).
limitations: human correlation was not reproduced; model scores are from artifact audit only

observations.summary: Cross-source category alignment from 6 category sets

claims.claim: RBench captures robotic video failure modes including structural distortion, floating components, and key-action omission (Figure 2).
limitations: real-video evaluation was not rerun; failure modes are source-traced only
